newsitem.title: UK: RTZ shares fall on talk of earnings downgrade.
newsitem.headline: RTZ shares fall on talk of earnings downgrade.

text.p: Shares in mining group RTZ fell on Thursday amid talk of an earnings downgrade from UBS and ahead of a presentation today on group coal operations, traders said.
The shares were 20-1/2p lower at 922p by 1112 GMT in volume of almost two million shares.

Traders said UBS analysts lowered their profit estimates on concern over the recent strengthening of sterling and also reduced their recommendation of the stock. The Anglo-Australian firm RTZ Corp Plc-CRA Ltd was due to hold a presentation on the group's coal operations for the Association of Mining Analysts at 1200 GMT today.
